source.title: Forebears Swaziland forenames and surnames frequency tables

names.notes: Public frequency tables were used to replace the legacy seed with localized samples. Eswatini remains a separate product GEO from Swaziland; gender buckets are review samples, not official civil-registry data.

source.title: ITU Eswatini national numbering plan communication of 11.VII.2025

phones.notes: ITU/ESCCOM confirms country code +268, eight-digit national significant numbers, existing mobile ranges 76-79, and the 75 mobile range introduced in 2025. Generated numbers are not checked for live assignment or portability.

source.title: UPU General Addressing Issues postcode-length table

locations.notes: UPU confirms a four-character postcode length for Eswatini. City and street samples are public-geography review data; postalPrefixes are generator prefixes and not full address validation.

national_identity_card_number.label: National Identity Card Number

source.title: Eswatini Government identity cards service requirements

national_identity_card_number.notes: Official source confirms identity-card issuance and PIN context for some applicants, but no public number grammar, checksum or semantic digit rule was confirmed. ID is a generator marker, not a claimed card prefix.

passport.label: Passport

source.title: Eswatini Government travel documents and passports requirements

passport.notes: Official source confirms Eswatini passport and travel-document issuance, but no public passport-number grammar was confirmed. SZ is a generator marker, not a claimed passport prefix.
